contract.title: Personal loan agreement
contract.subtitle: Consumer credit agreement concluded at a distance, issued and signed electronically.
contract.coverNotice: Contractual document issued by MOONYP SAS. It takes effect only after the borrower's electronic signature and the lender's final acceptance. Please keep it for the entire term of the credit.
contract.amountNote: Capital made available, excluding fees and insurance.
contract.s4: Part IV — Obligations of the parties
contract.s5: Part V — Insurance, guarantee and incidents
contract.a1b: This agreement is concluded between the lender identified below and the borrower whose identity, address and contact details appear in the credit file referenced in the header.
contract.a2b: The lender grants the borrower an amortising fixed-rate loan for the purpose declared in the file. The borrower confirms that the information provided is accurate and complete.
contract.a3b: The capital lent and the currency of the agreement are those shown in the table of financial conditions. No amount is due from the borrower before the funds are actually disbursed.
contract.a4b: The loan is repayable in equal monthly instalments over the term shown in the table of financial conditions, the first instalment falling due one month after disbursement.
contract.a5b: The borrowing rate is fixed for the entire term. The annual percentage rate of charge (APR) includes interest, arrangement fees and, where insurance is mandatory, the insurance premium.
contract.a6b: The monthly instalment, the total cost of credit and the total amount payable are detailed in the table of financial conditions and computed from the data held in the file.
contract.a7b: Arrangement fees appear in the table of financial conditions. No charge that is not stated in this agreement may be claimed from the borrower.
contract.a8b: Funds are transferred to the bank account declared by the borrower, after signature of the agreement and full verification of the file, including compliance and anti-money-laundering checks.
contract.a9b: Instalments are collected or paid on a fixed date. The borrower may repay early, in part or in full, under the conditions provided by the applicable regulations.
contract.a10b: Any unpaid instalment is notified to the borrower. In the event of persistent default, the lender may accelerate the loan and claim the outstanding capital, accrued interest and justified charges.
contract.a11b: The lender makes the funds available as agreed, keeps the borrower informed about the credit and provides the contractual documents and the repayment schedule.
contract.a12b: The borrower repays the instalments, keeps contact details up to date, reports any change of circumstances affecting solvency and uses the funds for the declared purpose.
contract.a13b: Where insurance is taken out, it is the subject of a separate contractual document attached to the file, stating the covers, the premium, the exclusions and the beneficiary.
contract.a14b: Where a guarantee is required, it is the subject of a separate deed attached to the file, stating its nature, amount, term and the guarantor's obligations.
contract.a15b: The borrower has fourteen calendar days from signature to withdraw, without reason or penalty, by written notice addressed to the lender.
contract.a16b: The agreement ends on payment of the final instalment. It may be terminated as of right in the event of misrepresentation, fraud or established payment default.
contract.a17b: Data is processed by MOONYP SAS to perform the agreement and comply with its legal obligations, in accordance with the GDPR. The borrower exercises their rights with the compliance department.
contract.a18b: The agreement is subject to the protective provisions of the law of the borrower's place of residence. Any complaint may be addressed to the lender's compliance department.
contract.rowTotalRepaid: Total amount payable by the borrower
contract.calloutAprBody: Credit commits you and must be repaid. Check your repayment capacity before committing. The amounts above are those recorded in your credit file.
contract.calloutWithdrawalBody: Fourteen calendar days from the electronic signature, without reason or penalty, by written notice addressed to the lender.
contract.sigIntro: The parties accept electronic signature as evidence of their consent, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 910/2014 (eIDAS).
contract.sigLenderMention: Signature affixed electronically by the lender; institutional seal of the document.
contract.sigBorrowerMention: Electronic signature of the borrower, time-stamped and bound to the document fingerprint.
contract.pendingMention: Electronic signature area — document awaiting the borrower's signature.
contract.qualifiedNotice: Qualified electronic signature within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 910/2014, equivalent to a handwritten signature.
contract.advancedNotice: Advanced electronic signature within the meaning of Regulation (EU) 910/2014: one-time code, time stamp, IP address and document fingerprint.
contract.fpNote: Any change to the file alters its fingerprint: it allows the integrity of the archived document to be verified.
contract.footer: MOONYP credit agreement — electronically generated document, valid without a handwritten signature.

guarantee.title: Credit guarantee deed
guarantee.subtitle: Separate contractual document attached to the credit file referenced in the header.
guarantee.coverNotice: This deed supplements the loan agreement of the same file. It states the nature, amount, term and conditions of the guarantee required by the lender.
guarantee.amountNote: Amount recorded in the credit file.
guarantee.s1: Part I — Parties and purpose of the guarantee
guarantee.s2: Part II — Conditions of the guarantee
guarantee.s4: Part IV — Legal provisions and signature
guarantee.a1b: This deed is concluded between the lender and the borrower of the credit file referenced in the header, together with the guarantor where a third-party guarantor is appointed.
guarantee.a2t: Purpose and nature of the guarantee
guarantee.a2b: The guarantee covers the lender's credit risk under the loan granted. Its nature is the one shown in the table of conditions below.
guarantee.a3b: The guaranteed amount and the currency are those recorded in the credit file and reproduced in the table of conditions.
guarantee.a4b: The guarantee may be called by the lender in the event of established payment default, after notifying the borrower and up to the guaranteed amount.
guarantee.a5b: The borrower pays the guarantee fee in accordance with the payment instructions in the file and informs the lender of any event affecting the guarantee.
guarantee.a6b: The lender allocates the guarantee solely to cover the credit concerned, informs the borrower and releases it once the debt is extinguished.
guarantee.a7b: The guarantee takes effect on acceptance and expires on full repayment of the credit or on termination of the loan agreement.
guarantee.a8b: Data in this deed is processed by MOONYP SAS to perform the agreement and comply with its legal obligations, in accordance with the GDPR.
guarantee.a9b: This deed follows the law applicable to the loan agreement to which it is attached. Any complaint is addressed to the lender's compliance department.
guarantee.calloutBody: No payment is deemed received on a mere declaration: only a validation by the lender's finance department evidences receipt of the guarantee fee.
guarantee.footer: MOONYP guarantee deed — electronically generated document attached to the credit file.

insurance.title: Borrower insurance contract
insurance.subtitle: Separate contractual document attached to the credit file referenced in the header.
insurance.coverNotice: This notice states the covers, premium, term, exclusions and beneficiary of the insurance attached to the loan agreement of the same file.
insurance.amountNote: Premium recorded in the credit file.
insurance.s2: Part II — Covers and financial conditions
insurance.s3: Part III — Term, exclusions and beneficiary
insurance.s4: Part IV — Legal provisions and signature
insurance.a1b: This contract binds the insured, who is also the borrower of the file referenced in the header, the insurer designated below and the lender as beneficiary.
insurance.a2b: The insurance covers the credit instalments in the cases and within the limits of the covers shown in the table below.
insurance.a3b: The covers are those recorded in the credit file and reproduced in the table of conditions. No cover that is not stated is owed by the insurer.
insurance.a4b: The monthly premium and any set-up fees appear in the table of conditions; they are included in the APR calculation where insurance is mandatory.
insurance.a5b: The insurance takes effect on the date shown in the table of conditions and ends at the end of the credit or on termination of the insurance contract.
insurance.a6b: Claims resulting from intentional misrepresentation, an undisclosed prior event or a risk expressly excluded from the covers taken out are not covered.
insurance.a7b: The lender is the beneficiary of the benefits up to the amounts outstanding under the credit; any balance reverts to the insured or their beneficiaries.
insurance.a8b: The insured notifies any claim to the lender or the insurer as soon as possible, providing the supporting documents requested.
insurance.a9b: Health and personal data is processed for insurance purposes only, in accordance with the GDPR and the applicable confidentiality rules.
insurance.a10b: This notice follows the law applicable to the loan agreement to which it is attached. Any complaint is addressed to the lender's compliance department.
insurance.calloutBody: The covers, exclusions and amounts above come exclusively from the credit file. Any change gives rise to a new version of this document.
insurance.footer: MOONYP insurance notice — electronically generated document attached to the credit file.
